disclaimer.title: RecDel
disclaimer.body1: RecDel works independently of WhatsApp. All data is stored locally on your device — nothing is collected or shared.
disclaimer.body2: "Deleted Message Recovery" only works via the Notification Access permission, and only for messages received after that permission is enabled. Deletions that happened before install are not recoverable.
disclaimer.body3: Only messages and media the other person sent can ever be recovered. RecDel cannot capture or reconstruct your own sent messages, since Android never generates a notification for your own outgoing messages.
disclaimer.body4: You are solely responsible for legal use of this app. It is intended for personal use only; misuse may be subject to legal action.
